content: {"episode_id":"ep-05117","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-50","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-50 denial of CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring) for this episode. The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness (R42) in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries (I25.10) and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0). As stated in the order, mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes that may be contributing to these symptomatic episodes. Given these documented diagnoses and the stated evaluation purpose, we request reconsideration of the medical necessity determination for the outstanding balance of 882.89."}
